basis: OS-RANGO-BUILD-003: host-reconcile.py --config for the isolated Rango builder (os/build-only/rango-isolated.json). Same projects, sparse paths, integration-owned roots and trusted patcher as the Frankel integration, so shadow-tree planning, owner-change conflicts, backups and immutable receipts are unchanged; nothing is adopted or reset. Differences, each deliberate: Rango paths only; no installedIdentities (Frankel 2701's expected identities describe Frankel phones, not the Fold); no --locked-control; and no Frankel updater channel. There is no published Rango channel, so the Updater is left upstream (--keep-upstream-updater): this build must not be offered as an update to an existing RoseOS phone, and the Rango channel stays an unresolved input (no URL is invented). host-reconcile.py takes no lock itself; run it under flock on host.lockPath (README.md). The inputs section pins the already downloaded public frankel 2026102901 release that rango-local-inputs.py verifies; its OTA is an app source only and is never installed on or offered to Rango.

product.basis: The delivered frankel 2026102901 product (PR #141 head). The recipe (this checkout's patcher) is recorded separately by hash in each reconcile receipt; product and recipe are not the same commit.
